corrections.title: Add Rule of Two note to the 3v3 The Stranger BANE counter
corrections.rationale: Explains Darth Bane's two-person Rule of Two mechanic on the 3v3 The Stranger BANE counter. Owner-agreed content (Group 4C, issue #37). Strategic-conservation advice is deliberately excluded; it belongs to C04 and the Round UI issue. SEE and SEE_BANE rows, tiers, banners, undersize and attacking identities are unchanged.

evidence.supports: Owner-agreed exact note text for the 3v3 The Stranger BANE counter (C02).
Rule of Two mechanic: exactly one other non-summoned Sith ally, including the GAC omicron. Mechanics guidance only, not proof of matchup success.
Exact before/after The Stranger row for review item C02 of CR-2026-10-11-01.

provenance.conditions: 3v3 The Stranger defence, BANE counter row only; defence and datacron conditions are stated in the note.
provenance.confidence: High for the mechanic description; the note makes no claim of matchup success.
provenance.limitations: The mechanics source was not re-fetched by the agent in this session; the wording is the owner-agreed text. No change to required members or Round availability.

affectedReferences.effect: BANE counter gains a notes property; SEE and SEE_BANE rows, all tiers, banners, undersize values and the counter order are unchanged.

runtimeImpact.3v3: The Stranger BANE counter shows the Rule of Two note; BANE stays S / 50 / undersize 1.

counters.notes: For Bane's Rule of Two, use exactly two attackers: Darth Bane plus one other non-summoned Sith ally; leave the third slot empty (undersize 1). SEE + Bane is the separate SEE_BANE counter. Check defence and datacron conditions.
